questions.question: Locate the Ninth Symphony anecdote in B. Kutzler’s Mathematikerwitze & Mathematikwitze (2005). The available two-page extract is a preface dated May 2005 and does not contain the story. Both versions retain the author’s qualification that no reliable earlier source has been found.
